method: Read all three bodies and the single new canonical header in full. Independently decoded the complete bounded retail CFGs (1061/230/249 bytes, 0x409330..0x409754, 0x409755..0x40983a, 0x40983b..0x409933), every branch direction and every ordered referent; then compiled the unit with the installed SP1 tools and compared all bytes with independent ordered-referent relocation. The decoded bodies agree instruction for instruction, including the plain-c2 `lea ebp,[esp-frame]` prologues, the GS cookie stores, the min-macro double-evaluation of wcslen, the signed 1024 comparisons in LoadSearchPath, and the shared 0x100c-page stack probe whose two public aliases resolve through the pinned entry-alias proof. No decompiler output is relied on; the older draft was used only as a hypothesis and every byte was re-verified.
abi_and_ownership: Public PDB starts 0x409330/0x409755 in DBI module 6 (loadui.obj) with the decorated names ?LoadUILibrary@@YAJPAG0KPAPAUHINSTANCE__@@0IPAK@Z (__cdecl long, seven parameters), ?LoadSearchPath@@YAPAUHINSTANCE__@@PAGI@Z and ?LoadCLUI@@YAPAUHINSTANCE__@@PAGI@Z (__cdecl HINSTANCE__*, two parameters). LoadSearchPath and LoadCLUI call LoadUILibrary by its exact mangled entry, and LoadCLUI calls LoadSearchPath; those ordered internal rel32 referents confirm same-unit ownership and the cdecl stack cleanup decoded at every call site (add esp,0x1c / pop).
preprocessing_abi_and_lines: The unit includes the installed SDK windows.h through the canonical project header plus the installed CRT stdlib.h/wchar.h/string.h. /Zc:wchar_t- keeps WCHAR/wchar_t as unsigned short, which is what the retail PAG/G manglings and literal symbols require. No body has an assert, __LINE__, __FILE__, line padding or a source-layout claim; the file begins with an explicit statement that the original source filename and line layout are unresolved. Parameter and local names are descriptive placeholders, never claimed as PDB names.
